title: Man. Post. Cap. VIII: imputation before consent — remedy overturns your view
pass_a_gloss: Yet you require that charge of Adam's actual sin to come before any consent of ours—habit or act. That shared remedy therefore topples your thesis more than it props it up.
pass_b_english: But you want the imputation of Adam's actual sin to precede all our consent, whether habitual or actual. Therefore this common remedy rather overturns your opinion than confirms it.
source_text: Vis autem imputationem peccati actualis Adami antecedere omnem nostrum sive habitualem, sive actualem consensum. Tuam igitur potius sententiam commune hoc remedium evertit, quam firmat.

choices.choice: Imputation before consent — remedy overturns not confirms

notes: Cap. VIII gospel densify section 457 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 306 tip–308 tip).
